RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a claim on the seat
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist who thinks little of the lord stands up and claims the seat itself.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText:
{PETITIONER_labelShort} steps forward and does not kneel. The hall goes quiet, because everyone understands before a word is said. The colony has been calling its lord weak for some time, and {PETITIONER_labelShort} has decided to say it to the seat itself: step down, and let someone rule who will.
The lord must answer his own accuser.
How does the lord rule?

li.label: The seat is won by the sword. Fight for it
li.pastLabel: the seat put to the sword

li.label: Bind {PETITIONER_labelShort} to the post, and let the colony see who sits
li.pastLabel: the challenger bound to the post
